# ProGene

> ProGene helps freelancers create accurately-priced, professional client proposals in under 5 minutes with a smart pricing engine, AI scope writer, and built-in e-signature.

ProGene is a SaaS platform for generating technical scopes, pricing, and proposals for web projects (Framer, Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, custom builds). Free tier includes 3 proposals; Pro and Agency plans unlock unlimited use plus client management, branding, time tracking, and analytics.

- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the ProGene team.
